doc.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Upcoming Blue Note dates and goodbye
summary: Brown asks about the Blue Note engagement with Cecil Taylor and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: And now to really bring this to a close, next week Elvin Jones at the Blue Note. And, as Keiko said, in December. So what are we in store for if I can make it back? Elvin Jones, I know you’re doing the two second sets with Cecil Taylor?
Then you’ll see me playing from a wheel chair. (Laughs)
After Cecil gets through with me! Enjoy it!
Yeah, sure! On a throne, whether it’s the drummer’s throne or a rolling throne, you’re on it. (Laughs) Okay well I think the table is being set!
Well while I think she’s getting everything set here I can take you downstairs.
Oh great! END OF INTERVIEW Transcribed by Kyle Kelly-Yahner
